claim.reading: The fraction of all rows where soilSourceSp is “CO” equals 71 % when rounded to the printed precision.

message: Under the stated reading, the data file does not give the printed number.
proposal_origin_note: Who proposed this reading. A proposer has no authority; only the checks below count.

assumptions: Rounding: the printed value 71 stands for any exact value within ±1/2 of it (rounding to the last printed digit, ties accepted either way).
Missing values: cells equal to one of ['', 'NA'] are excluded; the count of excluded rows is part of the proof.
Every other cell in the columns used is read as an exact decimal number; no rows are added, removed or reweighted.
Unit conversion: reported value = 100 × statistic in data units (fraction → %).
